name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-08-12.19.1) to the usual [second reading](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/) motion "*that the bill be read for a second time*," which is parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill.
